question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Generous
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Generous"** means showing a readiness to give more of something, especially money, than is strictly necessary or expected. (उदार)

 
 
• **Example: **She was **generous **with her time and helped everyone in the community.
 
 
 
• **"Mean" **refers to someone who is unwilling to give or share things, especially money; unkind or unfair. (कंजूस)
 
 
• **Example: **He was so **mean** that he wouldn't even lend his friend a small amount of money.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Generous' **is **'Mean'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Needy** (जरूरतमंद): Lacking the necessities of life; very poor.

 
 
• **Example:** The charity supports **needy** families in the local area.
 
 
 
• **Clever** (चतुर): Quick to understand, learn, and devise or apply ideas; intelligent.
 
 
• **Example:** She was very **clever **and always got top marks in her exams.
 
 
 
• **Considerate** (विचारशील): Showing concern for the rights and feelings of others.
 
 
• **Example:** He was **considerate** towards his neighbors and always helped them out.
